this entry accounts for. Any token the document names that is neither
covered here nor listed in humanVerifyOnly is reported as unchecked.

notCheckable.$comment: Claim CATEGORIES in DEMO-FLOWS.md that no check covers, with the reason. This is the honest remainder — everything here has to be verified by a person.
notCheckable.ui-copy-and-labels: Exact on-screen wording (the public-email block message, 'Chưa có giọng nào cho ngôn ngữ này', dialog summary text). Only checkable by regex over JSX, which false-positives on every restyle.
notCheckable.runtime-behaviour: Anything that only shows up when the system runs: the 3-second lobby poll, the 5-second artifact refresh, the 60-second suggestion strip, realtime room-list updates, SignalR billing updates, translation actually working.
notCheckable.permission-outcomes: RBAC results (Access Denied screens, 403 on Start Translation for non-hosts, HOST_ONLY artifacts, fail-closed meeting-creation gate). These need a real token and a running backend.
notCheckable.empty-state-and-cache: The lazy voice catalog being empty until warmed — a data condition, not a code fact.
notCheckable.settings-field-lists: The Settings page field inventory in Flow 1 step 8 and the AI usage policy list. Long, deeply nested form JSX; a regex here would break on every refactor.
notCheckable.flow-ordering-and-advice: The recommended flow order, the stage advice, and the whole preparation checklist — judgement, not facts about code.
notCheckable.cross-service-claims: The credit pricing model, artifact retention, and the append-only audit log. The migrations are named in the document but live in warptalk-backend's service-owned migrations; the existing scripts/test-migration-owner-contract.sh already guards that boundary.
